# package client

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102/client"
```

Package client is the controlling station of IEC 60870-5-102: the primary station of unbalanced transmission that reads integrated totals, single-point information, the product specification and the system time of one integrated total station (a meter or a data concentrator).

IEC 60870-5-102 is request driven: the client polls only while a request is open. A request is sent with send/confirm (function 3); the client then polls for user data, class 1 while the station sets ACD and class 2 otherwise, until the answer is complete:

  - UntilReply: the first ASDU of the station that is not the mirror of the request (C\_RD\_NA\_2 is answered by P\_MP\_NA\_2, C\_TI\_NA\_2 by M\_TI\_TA\_2);
  - UntilConfirmation: the activation confirmation, the request mirrored with cause 7;
  - UntilTermination: the activation termination, the request mirrored with cause 10, after the confirmation and the data (cause 5).

A mirror with the P/N bit or a cause 13..18 ends any request with an [\*iec102.RefusedError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#RefusedError). A mirror is an ASDU of the station with the type identification, common address and record address of the request ([iec102.ASDU.Mirrors](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#ASDU.Mirrors)) and its information object too: the requested addresses and time range. These procedures are those of the recorded traffic (innoWatt log: C\_AC\_NA\_2 confirmed with cause 7; C\_CI\_NU\_2 confirmed, 744 ASDUs M\_IT\_TK\_2 with cause 5, terminated with cause 10) and of gisce/iec870ree; the Beckhoff TS650x manual describes no application procedure. They are interpretations; see docs/iec102/INTEROPERABILITY.md.

The link is initialized (request status of link, reset of remote link) by [Client.Init](#func-client-init) or the first request, and again after the station stopped answering (link.ErrTimeout, which link.ErrUnexpected also wraps when only answers to something else came until the last time-out). Requests run one at a time; a second waits. A request that ends before its answer is complete (its context ended, or the link failed) leaves the rest of that answer at the station: the next request first polls the station until it has no more data and drops what of it belongs to its common address, so that it is not taken for the next answer.

## Constants

```go
const (
	DefaultPollInterval   = 50 * time.Millisecond
	DefaultRequestTimeout = 30 * time.Second
	// DefaultMaxResult is the default of Config.MaxResult: 131072 ASDUs
	// hold more than three years of quarter-hour integration periods, one
	// period to an ASDU.
	DefaultMaxResult = 1 << 17
)
```

#### func New

```go
func New(rw io.ReadWriter, cfg Config) (*Client, error)
```

New starts a controlling station on rw. Close stops it and closes rw when it is an io.Closer.

#### func (Client) Close

```go
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

Close stops the station. Outstanding requests, and requests made afterwards, fail with [iec102.ErrClosed](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#ErrClosed). Close is safe to call more than once and from several goroutines: the first call closes the transport and returns its error; later calls return nil.

Called from the Handler, Close cannot wait for the Handler's goroutine: it stops the client and returns nil at once, and the close completes, StateClosed reported included, when the Handler has returned.

#### func (Client) Done

```go
func (c *Client) Done() <-chan struct{}
```

Done is closed when the station stops: after Close, when the transport fails, or when a callback did not return normally. Err tells which.

#### func (Client) Err

```go
func (c *Client) Err() error
```

Err returns the error that stopped the station: the transport's, or that of a callback that did not return normally (wrapping [iec102.ErrClosed](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#ErrClosed)); nil while it runs or after Close.

#### func (Client) Init

```go
func (c *Client) Init(ctx context.Context) error
```

Init initializes the link: request status of link, then reset of remote link (IEC 60870-5-2 as profiled by IEC 60870-5-101:2003, clause 6.2; gisce/iec870ree and daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102 do the same).

#### func (Client) ReadProductSpec

```go
func (c *Client) ReadProductSpec(ctx context.Context) (iec102.ProductSpec, error)
```

ReadProductSpec reads the manufacturer and product specification: C\_RD\_NA\_2 with cause 5, answered by P\_MP\_NA\_2 (gisce/iec870ree).

#### func (Client) ReadSinglePoints

```go
func (c *Client) ReadSinglePoints(ctx context.Context, record uint8, from, to *iec102.TimeA) ([]iec102.SinglePoint, error)
```

ReadSinglePoints reads the single-point information of record address record (a list address 50..55, Beckhoff TS650x manual, section 9.1.8): all of it with C\_SP\_NA\_2, or the time range from..to with C\_SP\_NB\_2 when both are given; cause 6. Single points of another record address are left out.

#### func (Client) ReadTime

```go
func (c *Client) ReadTime(ctx context.Context) (iec102.TimeB, error)
```

ReadTime reads the current system time of the station: C\_TI\_NA\_2 with cause 5, answered by M\_TI\_TA\_2 (gisce/iec870ree).

#### func (Client) ReadTotals

```go
func (c *Client) ReadTotals(ctx context.Context, record uint8, q iec102.Read) ([]iec102.IntegratedTotals, error)
```

ReadTotals reads integrated totals with one of the read commands C\_CI\_NA\_2 .. C\_CI\_NU\_2 (q.T; the fields q carries depend on it, see iec102.Read) from record address record, with cause 6, and returns the integration periods the station sent for that record address, in order. Integrated totals of another record address are not part of the answer and are left out. The type family of the answer is not checked: meters of the REE profile answer some reads with another family.

#### func (Client) Request

```go
func (c *Client) Request(ctx context.Context, a *iec102.ASDU, until Until) (_ []*iec102.ASDU, err error)
```

Request sends a and collects the station's answers until the request is complete by rule until. It returns every ASDU of the station's common address received meanwhile, the mirrors included. A refusal returns the answers so far and an [\*iec102.RefusedError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#RefusedError). An answer of more ASDUs than Config.MaxResult ends the request with the ASDUs so far and an error wrapping [iec102.ErrResultLimit](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#ErrResultLimit).

When an earlier request ended before its answer was complete, Request first polls the station until it reports no more data, dropping what of that answer arrives (ASDUs of other common addresses still reach the Handler); the rest of an abandoned answer is never returned as the answer of this request.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// Link holds the link timing (Timeout, Retries) and hooks; Link.FT12
	// is set from LinkAddrSize.
	Link link.Config
	// LinkAddrSize is the size of the link address field: 1 or 2 octets,
	// [iec102.NoLinkAddr] for none. Zero means
	// [iec102.DefaultLinkAddrSize].
	LinkAddrSize int
	// LinkAddr is the link address of the integrated total station.
	LinkAddr uint16
	// CommonAddr is the common address of ASDU (the REE profile's
	// measuring point address) the requests carry.
	CommonAddr uint16
	// Params are the codec parameters: common address size, time zone and
	// profile (for example ree.Profile).
	Params iec102.Params

	// PollInterval is the pause between polls the station answers without
	// data while a request is open. Zero means [DefaultPollInterval].
	PollInterval time.Duration
	// RequestTimeout bounds every request whose context has no deadline.
	// Zero means [DefaultRequestTimeout]; long load profiles need more.
	RequestTimeout time.Duration
	// MaxResult bounds the ASDUs one request collects: the request that
	// would collect more ends with an error wrapping
	// [iec102.ErrResultLimit], with the ASDUs so far, instead of growing
	// until its deadline. Zero means [DefaultMaxResult]; negative means no
	// bound, as before v0.6.0.
	MaxResult int

	// Handler receives the ASDUs that answer no request: those of another
	// common address. It runs on a goroutine of its own, in order, through
	// a queue of 64 ASDUs; one that does not fit is dropped and logged. It
	// may call the client's methods: a request from it waits for the
	// request in progress like any other. It may call Close, which then
	// does not wait for the Handler's goroutine: it returns at once, the
	// Handler is not called again, and the close completes when the
	// Handler has returned. A Handler that does not return normally is
	// logged with its stack and closes the client; Err reports it. The
	// ASDU is the Handler's own: the client keeps no reference to it.
	Handler func(a *iec102.ASDU)
	// OnState is called with each change of the link state, from the
	// goroutine of the request that changed it (while that request holds
	// the request slot), or from Close for StateClosed. It must return
	// quickly. It must not issue a request, which waits for the request
	// slot the calling request holds; start one in a new goroutine. It may
	// call Close; the request then fails with [iec102.ErrClosed]. An
	// OnState that does not return normally is logged and closes the
	// client, as for the Handler; the request fails with ErrClosed.
	OnState func(s iec102.State, err error)
	// Logger receives the log entries; nil is silent.
	Logger iec60870.Logger
}
```
